metcon.name: Workout
metcon.description:
Warm Up Equipment:
PVC Pipe
Red Band
Empty Barbell
Box
Rig
1 Round:
30sec e/s PVC Shoulder Opener
5 PVC Around the Worlds each way
5 PVC Pass Throughs
10 Band Row → Rotate → Press
5e/s World’s Greatest Stretch
10 Air Squats
30 Handstand Hold on wall
2 Rounds:
Gymnastics
5 Scap Pull-Ups
5 Beat Swings
3 Kip Swings + Hip-to-Bar
Barbell
3 Muscle Snatches
3 Hang Power Snatches
3 Power Cleans

hypertrophy.reasoning: Snatches and cleans heavily tax quads, traps, and lats; accessorize antagonists and weak points.
